FAIL.summary: Access is not restricted to assignments, or no user, group or service has been assigned.
actions: In Entra admin center, open Enterprise applications and find this application using its enterprise application Object ID.
Open Properties, set Assignment required? to Yes and save.
Open Users and groups and assign the approved users or groups. If access is service-to-service, ask the application administrator to assign the approved service principal instead.
Run the report again. This check passes when assignment is required and at least one assignment exists.

UNKNOWN.summary: The report could not read the assignment setting, so it cannot confirm whether access is restricted.
actions: Ask the report administrator to check the collection errors and the reader application's Application.Read.All consent.
Run collection again before changing access settings based on incomplete evidence.
